title: Earth's Moon
text: The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite, formed roughly 4.5 billion years ago, likely from debris after a Mars-sized body collided with early Earth. It has no atmosphere and takes about 27.3 days to orbit Earth. The Moon's gravitational pull causes ocean tides. Its phases (new, crescent, quarter, gibbous, full) result from changing angles between the Sun, Earth, and Moon as it orbits.
